description: Candid photograph of former President Bill Clinton, in a blue fleece vest over a white shirt, posing with his arm around an unidentified young woman wearing a cream knit beanie and dark cardigan. The setting appears to be the interior of a private aircraft cabin with polished burl-wood paneling, red trim, an illuminated EXIT sign, and a small seatback screen. This image circulated widely in Q-adjacent communities with captions claiming it shows Clinton with photographer Rachel Chandler aboard Jeffrey Epstein's plane; the image itself contains no caption and neither the woman's identity nor the location is verifiable from the photo.
flags: Unverified circulating claim: woman identified in captions elsewhere as Rachel Chandler and location as Epstein's jet — neither is verifiable from the image itself
Young woman not identified from the image; possible private individual

description: Screenshot of a fashion article headlined 'Models to Watch in 2017, as Predicted By Midland Agency's Rachel Chandler and Walter Pearce', bylined Katherine Cusumano, December 30 2016. Below the intro paragraph is a grid of fifteen casting-style portrait photos of young models against plain backdrops; none are named in the visible text. The article describes Midland as a boutique casting and model management agency run by Chandler and Pearce and presents 16 models to watch. The outlet's name is not visible in the crop; the piece is consistent with W Magazine's article of that title.
text: Models to Watch in 2017, as Predicted By Midland Agency's Rachel Chandler and Walter Pearce. by Katherine Cusumano. December 30, 2016 11:25 am. In early December, Rachel Chandler and Walter Pearce of the new boutique casting and model management agency Midland had already begun preparations for the Fall 2017 season. And while the pair couldn't discuss their upcoming projects in any detail, they were clear on one thing: These are the models poised to have a breakout year. See Midland's 16 models to watch in the new year, from street cast newcomers to Midland's own signees. EYE CONTACT
flags: The fifteen pictured models are unnamed private individuals and are not identified
Publishing outlet not visible in the screenshot; attribution to W Magazine is inferred, not shown

description: Research-style collage assembling photos and clippings to connect casting agent Rachel Chandler with designer/actor Waris Ahluwalia and the Clintons. It includes a BFA event photo labeled 'Rachel Chandler - Waris Ahluwalia'; a WWD article headline about Ahluwalia designing a pendant for the Clinton Foundation's 10th-anniversary gala and Bill Clinton's 65th birthday; a photo captioned 'Waris Ahluwalia & Marina Abramovic'; a turbaned studio portrait of Ahluwalia with a quote about his first encounter with the 42nd President; a @0HOUR1___ tweet ('Moving fast #LolitaExpress... with Rachel Chandler') showing the circulated photo of Bill Clinton with a young woman in a beanie in an aircraft cabin; and a photo-agency metadata panel naming Rachel Chandler Guinness, Heidi Bivens, and Waris Ahluwalia at an ASMALLWORLD dinner at Haven's Kitchen, NYC. All connections are the collage's claims; most identifications come from the embedded captions.

description: Black-and-white photograph, apparently a screenshot of an art/photography image. A woman seen from behind, hair in a ponytail, holds a boxy camera or instant-film device with a small label aloft, aimed at a pair of hands at the right edge holding up a naked newborn-sized infant or a lifelike baby doll against an open sky, with a dark treeline below. It is not determinable from the image whether the infant is real or a doll, where this was taken, or who is pictured. The composition reads as a staged art photograph; the filename indicates it circulated as a March 2019 screen capture.
